title: Video Production Internship
jobDescription:
Are you passionate about storytelling through videos? Do you have a flair for creating visually stunning and engaging content? Start Genie , a fast-growing digital marketing agency, is looking for enthusiastic Videography & Editing Interns to join our team! Internship Details:
- First Month: Unpaid internship
- From 2nd Month Onwards: Paid internship (up to ₹10,000/month, performance-based)
- Location: Bengaluru, Hybrid (offline/online as per project needs)

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Collaborate with our creative team to produce captivating video content for clients.
- Handle videography for campaigns, advertisements, and social media projects.
- Edit videos with precision, incorporating animations, transitions, and effects.
- Contribute to brainstorming sessions to develop impactful visual stories.
- Ensure timely delivery of high-quality video projects. Requirements:
- Basic knowledge of videography and video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software).
- A portfolio of work (college projects or freelance work accepted).
- Creativity, attention to detail, and a passion for storytelling.
- Strong team collaboration skills and ability to meet deadlines. Perks:
- Work with a dynamic digital marketing agency on real-time client projects.
- Mentorship from experienced professionals.
- Certificate of internship and a potential full-time opportunity based on performance. Let’s create something amazing together! Apply now!

title: Client Acquisition Internship (Performance-Based)
jobDescription:
Duration: 2 Months Location: Remote/Hybrid (as applicable) Stipend: ₹5,000 per month for a duration of two months. In addition to the stipend, performance-based incentives will be provided as follows:
- ₹3,000 for each successful client conversion. About Us: Start Genie is a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping brands scale through impactful strategies across social media, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, and more. We’re looking for passionate individuals to join our team and drive client acquisition for our services. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Identify and reach out to potential leads through online and offline channels
- Pitch Start Genie’s services confidently and effectively
- Follow up on leads and convert them into long-term clients
- Coordinate with the internal team for onboarding new clients
- Maintain a record of outreach, responses, and conversions Who Can Apply: Self-starters who can work independently and deliver results Students/freshers with a knack for communication and networking Individuals interested in digital marketing, sales, or business development Skills Required: Strong follow-up and negotiation skills Excellent verbal and written communication Persuasive and confident pitch delivery Basic knowledge of digital marketing (preferred, not mandatory) What You Get: Performance-based stipend as mentioned Hands-on experience in client acquisition Opportunity to work with a dynamic, creative team Certificate & Letter of Recommendation upon successful completion Ready to grow with us? Apply now and be part of Start Genie’s client success journey!

title: Graphic Designer – Canva Specialist (Visual & Video Content)
jobDescription: About Us: At Start Genie, we’re passionate about powering startups and brands with smart marketing solutions. From social media and branding to affiliate and e-commerce strategies, we help businesses grow with purpose. Now, we’re expanding our creative team! Role Overview: We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer who is highly proficient in Canva and has a knack for designing engaging visual content and short-form videos. If you understand what works on platforms like Instagram Reels and can turn ideas into eye-catching visuals — we want to hear from you! What You’ll Do: Design social media creatives, banners, carousels, and brand assets using Canva Create and edit short videos (Reels, You Tube Shorts, Ads) within Canva Repurpose existing content into platform-optimized visuals and videos Collaborate with the content and strategy team to execute marketing campaigns Maintain visual consistency across all client brands and formats What You’ll Need: Proven experience with Canva for both design and basic video editing Understanding of Instagram Reels/Shorts trends, transitions, and storytelling A strong portfolio showcasing your Canva work (graphics + short videos) Good communication and time management skills A proactive mindset with attention to detail Nice to Have: Familiarity with Cap Cut or other mobile editing tools Basic understanding of animation or motion graphics Prior freelance or agency experience Interest or experience in wellness, tech, or lifestyle branding Perks: ✔ Work from anywhere ✔ Freedom to explore creative ideas ✔ Potential for long-term collaboration ✔ Be part of a growing, energetic team
